title: Certified whole-domain bounds and equality barriers for the odd theta–Weil form
description: Explicit certified lower bounds on the full complex odd theta–Weil form domain, with positive-energy tradeoffs, complete residual coupling and a quantitative equality barrier. Includes a mathematical supplement, reproducible finite certificate checks and a pinned Lean project checking the central abstract proof chain and exact rational consequences conditional on stated analytical inputs. RH, zero-loss positivity, the even-sector argument and the full Li transfer remain unresolved.
